title: Intersectional descriptive distribution of the frozen V2 composite across provided strata
intent: Descriptive screen of the frozen model prediction distribution across intersections of provided region, urban/rural, vulnerability, tribal, and hazard strata. Not target validation, accuracy assessment, causal analysis, or operational claim.

statistics.cell_summary: count and arithmetic mean/sample standard deviation of the frozen V2 score; score summaries are emitted only for cells with count >= cell_threshold
statistics.metric: maximum absolute pairwise standardized mean difference among eligible cells within each intersection family; reported overall maximum is the maximum of those family maxima
statistics.standardized_mean_difference: abs(mean_a - mean_b) / sqrt(((n_a - 1) * sd_a^2 + (n_b - 1) * sd_b^2) / (n_a + n_b - 2)); sample standard deviations use ddof=1
statistics.comparison_scope: all unordered pairs of distinct eligible observed cells within the same intersection family; no comparisons across different hazard-family partitions
statistics.missing_policy: Use the existing v2-strata-descriptive-preregistered.json labels and assign_label rules. Missing/undefined provided values are explicit categories; never impute or silently drop a scored GEOID.
statistics.zero_cell_policy: Report observed cells (count > 0) as eligible or suppressed. Unobserved Cartesian combinations have count zero and are counted separately, not represented as observed cells.
statistics.interpretation: Purely descriptive differences among model predictions; no organizer targets, inferential significance, causal effect, or operational impact is implied.
